title: Stage 6's scope is derived from the graph, not from a flag
statement: The set of assertions stage 6 checks is computed from `restsOn` on active runbook steps (and any other graph use decided at the time), and contains no reference to the `loadBearing` field.
notes: ⚠️ Written BEFORE the work, and `not-evaluated` is the honest state. Added 2026-08-22 because the first real publication shipped TSK-0002 with nothing that could say when it was done — a task a recipient could work on forever without any artifact disagreeing.
